rows.Create Table:
CREATE TABLE `products` (
  `id` int unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `name` varchar(100) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'unnamed' COMMENT 'Product name',
  `price` decimal(10,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0.00',
  `status` enum('draft','published') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft',
  `tags` set('a','b','c') DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime(3) DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3),
  `category_id` int DEFAULT NULL,
  `data` json DEFAULT NULL,
  `bits` bit(4) DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `products_name_uq` (`name`),
  KEY `products_price_idx` (`price`,`status`),
  KEY `products_category_fk` (`category_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `products_category_fk` FOREIGN KEY (`category_id`) REFERENCES `categories` (`id`) ON DELETE SET NULL ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `products_price_chk` CHECK ((`price` >= 0))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci COMMENT='Products'
